question: GQ-007
subject: the one language rule I never tested for false positives

the_defect.rule: German flagged a title on ONE marker; every other language rule requires two
the_defect.the_five: all unambiguously German — Versuche und Beobachtungen über, Beiträge zur gerichtlichen Chemie

the_34_wrongly_excluded.von: a German NAME particle in "Justus von Liebig : his life and work" — an ENGLISH biography
the_34_wrongly_excluded.des: FRENCH, in "Système des connaissances chimiques" (32 volumes wrongly labelled german)

why_i_missed_it: I wrote "a filter tuned on one example is a filter that excludes good books" two turns ago while adding Italian and French with two-marker thresholds — and left the German rule, written first, at one marker.

after_the_fix.french_now_labelled_french: Système des connaissances chimiques was being called german

a_test_of_mine_that_failed_wrongly.what: my 5-case test reported 4/5, failing on the Priestley title
a_test_of_mine_that_failed_wrongly.cause: I truncated the test string before "der" — the real title carries three markers
a_test_of_mine_that_failed_wrongly.lesson: the rule was right and my abbreviated fixture was wrong

sixth_want_list.music_skipped: 3,492 available but his tier list says store-but-do-not-extract

batch_result.note: no BAD_BODY failures at all — a first across six want-lists

the_first_exact_title_duplicate_in_927_b.title: Annual report of the progress of chemistry and the allied sciences...
the_first_exact_title_duplicate_in_927_b.evidence: 2,201 vs 2,483 passages, 1.9 MB vs 2.2 MB, different opening text — two YEARS of an annual serial
the_first_exact_title_duplicate_in_927_b.cause: IA truncates long titles, so the volume distinction falls off the end
two_fixes: the report now prints passage counts alongside the title, so a reader can tell a truncated serial from a real duplicate without querying
--strict now fails on identical CONTENT (matching passage counts), not identical strings
the_first_exact_title_duplicate_in_927_b.why_it_matters: a gate that fails on a metadata artefact teaches me to bypass it
